item.title: 08-01 Point of Transition. Request for a Bridge (Pahlavi)
item.description: After the collapse of fear and the restoration of identity, Persia faces a dangerous vacuum. This work explores Pahlavi as a mechanism of continuity that connects the memory of Cyrus the Great with modern democratic institutions, allowing the transition from tyranny to democracy without structural collapse.
